NBA DFS Rankings for Tuesday, October 27 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, October 27 · 4 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 27, 7:53 PM ET

Luka Doncic (LAL) ranks first on the Tuesday, October 27 DraftKings main slate at 58.1 projected DraftKings points for $11,300. Victor Wembanyama (SAS, 55.0) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.6) are next.

The table ranks all 81 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 27, 7:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
